newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba down on earnings speculation.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba down on earnings speculation.

text.p: Shares in Japanese electronics maker Toshiba Corp remained weak in Tokyo's afternoon session on Wednesday after falling briefly below 700 yen for the first time since February 12, brokers said.
Sales were ignited by market speculation that its group earnings result for this fiscal year may be weaker than the company has expected, brokers said.

As of 0443 GMT, the shares were down 14 yen at 701 yen after falling as low as 695 yen earlier in the afternoon session. The turnover was 3.87 million shares, the third biggest volume on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
"Some foreign and domestic brokerages appear to think the company's group earnings for this fiscal year may be lower than the company had expected," a second-tier Japanese brokerage official said.
